description: The Caverncrawler is a nightmarish, centipede-like creature that lurks in dark, damp caves. Its segmented body is covered in thick, stone-like plates, making it difficult to damage. It uses its many legs to scuttle along walls and ceilings as easily as the ground, ambushing unsuspecting prey with its venomous fangs.
damage_resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The Caverncrawler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ambush Predator
traits.description: The Caverncrawler has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn’t taken a turn in combat yet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Caverncrawler makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Tail Swipe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
